svg.title: The two-loop verification structure of test 3
svg.desc: Diagram showing the two sequential loops inside test 3: the first loop iterates over nine figure_nodes and asserts each one's literal appears in source for nine total assertions, the second loop iterates over seven figure_edges and asserts each tuple literal appears in source for seven total assertions, all sixteen assertions must pass for the test to be green, with the structure presented as two parallel columns of green check marks.
svg.text: Test 3 — two loops, sixteen assertions, all must pass
Loop 1 runs to completion before Loop 2 starts. If any node check fails, Loop 2 never executes.
If any single one of the 16 assertions fails, pytest reports which loop and which literal — instant diagnosis.
